playtest_note: main_route and safe_platform_indices refer to the identical authored solid path. Optional branch indices are separate. Physics are root-owned; these geometry checks do not certify controller reachability.

levels.name: Lantern Quay
levels.lesson: Teach variable jump and safe landing; the first gaps are only24pixels.
beats: Wide224px starting dock, two approachable stars, optional seal clearly above.
First beetle has a176px platform and a24px patrol.
Gentle16px roof rise, generous checkpoint landing, slightly longer final rooftop.

seal_routes.technique: Two small hops above a broad dock; the first visible seal.
Follow the rising star trail; drop back onto the checkpoint dock.
Use a held jump, then cross the short rooftop gap.

levels.name: Apricot Rooftops
levels.lesson: Repeat a16px rising roof rhythm, then invert it; teach deliberate jump release.
beats: Three ascending roof heights128/112/96, then a courtyard breath.
Upper eaves preserve the same silhouette and16/24px rises.
Second rooftop phrase reverses the first; a lantern supports the highest seal.

seal_routes.technique: Climb the two roof eaves; release jump for the tight landing.
Choose the upper eave from the flat resting courtyard.
A high ledge rewards a short dash between equal-height roofs.

levels.name: Kitewake Causeway
levels.lesson: Introduce lantern refresh over safe land, then offer a three-step aerial kite route.
beats: First48px main gap, open landing128px wide.
Central ground runway lets the player watch the airborne kite route before choosing it.
Final248px causeway is a celebratory run to the harbor gate.

seal_routes.technique: Begin with a familiar two-hop roof before the dash lesson.
Chain the two hanging kite lanterns with an air dash.
One final lantern lets a brave jump keep its forward flow.

levels.name: Lotus After Rain
levels.lesson: Introduce side-route springs while keeping the ground route gentle.
beats: Familiar24px stepping-stone gaps beneath an optional high lotus.
One owl circles above a seal route, never the first spring.
Second spring sequence repeats the setup with a higher view of the jade rain.

seal_routes.technique: Bounce from the little lotus spring onto the pearl ledge.
A calm mid-level lotus climb above the checkpoint pool.
Repeat the spring climb with a longer second landing.

levels.name: Rainbell Canopy
levels.lesson: Teach crumble platforms above forgiving ground; practice alternating roof heights.
beats: First crumbling upper platform drops to a main-route landing instead of a pit.
Broad192px low platform resets the rhythm at the checkpoint.
Second half alternates high and low boughs with an optional timed upper shortcut.

seal_routes.technique: The first crumble leaf sits over solid canopy; keep moving across.
A three-tier leaf stair lets hesitation fall back to the safe path.
Leap quickly from the last brittle leaf into a broad upper bough.

levels.name: Glasswater Run
levels.lesson: Join rise-and-fall landings into a flowing run; upper routes ask for repeated dash refresh.
beats: Two broad low banks invite acceleration before the48px crossing.
Raised128/112/96/112 wave makes one readable movement phrase.
Final two wide landings leave a clean sprint to the rain gate.
The river launches Kip from a main-route spring into the long glasswater leap.

seal_routes.technique: A short roof climb offers a quiet view before the water run.
Two lanterns carry a rising dash chain over a safe riverbank.
A longer airborne ribbon finishes with an equal-height dash.

levels.name: Brass Moonworks
levels.lesson: A metronomic low/high pattern makes workshop movement musical and readable.
beats: The first repeated128/112 beat uses24px gaps and wide gear tops.
An184px central workshop provides recovery and checkpoint.
A final96px gear peak recasts the earlier brass spring route without requiring a spring.

seal_routes.technique: A brass spring launches the first gear balcony.
Climb above the midpoint workshop and its low patrol.
Keep moving across a brittle gear tooth into the upper gallery.

levels.name: Pendulum Steps
levels.lesson: Use an ascending and descending staircase for precise short-jump rhythm.
beats: A four-step128/112/96/80 climb has no sudden32px wall.
Descending stairs lead into the checkpoint shelf and a broad low rest.
The second climb is shorter; the seal extends it into a separate high phrase.
A brittle main-route ledge teaches commitment; a lower catch shelf forgives hesitation.

seal_routes.technique: A little side stair mirrors the bigger staircase.
A flat upper walkway rewards a short dash before the descending run.
Read the rising pendulum rhythm and take the upper final balcony.

levels.name: Sleepwheel Express
levels.lesson: Main-route48px gaps alternate low runway and high gear; optional crumble chains reward speed.
beats: A long starting station previews the express48px rhythm.
Checkpoint rests on a broad gear between two repeating wave phrases.
The final200px station lets the player land, exhale, and leave the moonworks.
A brittle main-route ledge teaches commitment; a lower catch shelf forgives hesitation.

seal_routes.technique: The first sleepwheel tooth crumbles above a stable station.
Commit to a rising express route; two lanterns keep the scarf charged.
A quick equal-height dash skips the last brittle cog.

levels.name: Whale in the Sky
levels.lesson: A gentle scenic breath turns familiar harbor rhythms into the whale spine.
beats: No opening pit for408px; give the colossal whale scene time to read.
Three broad low shelves and only16px rises create a calm before the final challenges.
Three easy seals echo the first stage so the player feels their improvement.

seal_routes.technique: An easy star-spine climb welcomes the final world.
Climb beside the whale eye; the broad spine catches missed landings.
One familiar rooftop phrase becomes a pearl ridge on the whale.

levels.name: Stardrift Current
levels.lesson: Combine climb, descent and chained lantern dash with wide fallback shelves.
beats: A mirrored128/112/96/112/128 wave anchors the main route.
Central192px checkpoint shelf supports an optional rising aerial chain.
A second wave sharpens the upper route while the ground rhythm remains readable.
The final current opens a 96px main gap; a hanging lantern rewards the taught air-dash chain.

seal_routes.technique: A precise climb prepares the aerial current.
Three pearl islands and two lanterns create the most expressive rising dash line.
An upper48px gap at equal height asks for a clean charged scarf dash.

levels.name: Heart of Moonwake
levels.lesson: Restate familiar movement before a spacious six-hit dream-knot finale.
beats: Opening roof phrase recalls the harbor without introducing a new rule.
All three optional seals occur before the arena; none requires boss farming.
Final360px continuous floor creates a two-screen arena without pits; the gate opens on boss defeat.

seal_routes.technique: A familiar lantern-quiet balcony before the last ascent.
Take one last optional climb beside the checkpoint spine.
The final pearl seal is before the arena, with a clear fall back to the main route.
